title: Gemini on the mobile app

body.text: Gemini has apps for Android and iOS that
give you the experience of having an AI assistant in your pocket all the time
— talk to it, snap a photo and ask, or even use it in place of Google Assistant on Android devices.

example: "[On mobile] Take a photo of a foreign-language sign and tap 'Ask about this image' to translate it instantly."

title: Standout features in Gemini mobile

body.text: The Gemini mobile app has special features like
Live Camera Mode, which analyzes what the camera sees in real time
, plus notifications that let you reach Gemini faster from your home screen.

example: "[Open Camera Mode] Point the camera at a food menu and ask 'About how many calories is this dish?'"
